title: Resolving Black Hole Singularities in Jackiw-Teitelboim Gravity
summary: In Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity, the naive Schwarzian quantum mechanics leads to a continuous bulk spectrum, in apparent contradiction with the finite entropy of the black hole, which requires a discrete spectrum with level spacing of order $e^{-S_0}$. It was recently shown that restoring spectral discreteness with random statistics requires the introduction of a left confining potential that becomes relevant when the renormalized wormhole length reaches order $e^{S_0}$. In this work, we show how the known perturbative results of JT gravity are recovered within this modified framework. More…
